 Social Security benefits to increase 3.6% in 2027 
 Medicare Part B premiums also rise, Marshall Clay of The Welch Group says 
 Social Security beneficiaries will see a 3.6% cost-of-living increase on their benefits in 2027. By Jonathan Skinner Published : Nov. 17, 2026 at 5:06 PM CST | Updated : 10 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google HUNTSVILLE, Ala. ( WAFF ) - Social Security beneficiaries will see a 3.6% cost-of-living increase on their benefits in 2027, Marshall Clay of The Welch Group said.
 Social Security increase
 Clay said the increase is based on the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers. It’s calculated each year, using the first three quarters of the calendar year to determine the next year’s increase.
 The average beneficiary will see an increase of about $75 per month, Clay said. The average Social Security benefit is about $2,095 per month but will rise to about $2,170 per month in 2027.
 Medicare Part B premiums
 Clay said Medicare Part B premiums will also increase by about 3.25%. He said the premium will go from $202.90 per month in 2026 to $209.50 per month next year.
 Clay said that is about a $ 6-per-month increase. He said beneficiaries will still come out a little better off after the premium increase.
 Income-related thresholds
 Clay also discussed income-related monthly adjustment surcharge amounts, which he said were covered in the previous two weeks.
 Clay said the first threshold for a single filer was $109,000 last year. It moves to $112,000 in 2027. For a couple married filing jointly, he said it goes up to about $224,000.
 Social Security wage base limit
 Clay said the Social Security wage base limit is the amount of wage base income subject to FICA and Social Security taxes. For people who are currently working, he said, the limit increases from $184,000 to $192,000.
 Clay said that means some workers will pay Social Security tax on more of their income.
